name: ManiSkill 3 Demonstrations: Large-Scale Trajectories for Embodied Manipulation
description: ManiSkill 3 Demonstrations is an open-access robotic demonstration dataset accompanying the GPU-parallelized ManiSkill 3 manipulation benchmark. Developed by the Hao Su Lab at UC San Diego, this collection provides standardized demonstration trajectories across rigid-body and soft-body robotic manipulation tasks (including PickCube, StackCube, PegInsertionSide, PlugCharger, PushCube, PushT, AnymalC-Reach, and bimanual TwoRobotStackCube). Stored in HDF5 format, the demonstrations provide environment states, actions, and reset configurations that can be replayed across any observation mode (RGB, depth, point cloud, or state observations) and simulation backend.
